comment: Control lot (docs/next/v3-challenge.md §6): mix and quotas of v3-jouer-a unchanged, current generator with only the C1 cleaning on top of v3. No type quota, no single-decision quota, no per-entry or slot ceiling; no_decision off (min_decisions 0 on every entry). The generator keeps its other changes since v3: neighbors kept (an export imposed), notation A, demand-price seeding only when a quota asks (none here). One change to the quotas: min_per_rating 3 for Facile, Moyen and Difficile, 0 for Expert. Under notation A an Expert needs STEP and a CO2 cap both coupled to an exchange, and no entry of v3-jouer-a has both: with 3 Experts required the lot stalled at 17/20.
